cover_letter_text:
I am applying for the Construction Materials Testing Technician, Entry-Level role with Coffey Testing in Werribee, advertised on SEEK. Your advert says a new starter works alongside experienced technicians in the laboratory and on construction sites, collecting samples, performing tests and recording results.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on construction sites in the Philippines. As project-in-charge engineer I carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As field engineer I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks and pavement systems. The Australian Standards in that course included AS 1289 and AS 1726.

I am based in Melton VIC and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence, and have my own reliable transport for travel to project sites. Could we arrange a call to talk about the role?
Marc Masarate
notes: Imported from the backlog of 2026-11-13 (old status READY_EMPLOYER_PORTAL). Fit 68% is from the old rubric.
